description: CFD mesh refinement with subcycling in time (G 7 1): the patch takes two steps per step of level 0, the cells around it linear in time; the projection of the patch alone with the flux of level 0 at its edges.
covers: cfd_amr_sub: Berger-Oliger steps, time interpolation of the coarser level, restriction
pr_level: level projection with the coarse flux at the patch edges, compatible right-hand side of a closed patch
